name: TrafficAlignedA
prompt: Create a production 2D painted sprite atlas for a Road Rash PC/3DO-inspired motorcycle racing game. Original designs only, high-detail painted realistic sprites, actual transparent RGBA background. Atlas EXACTLY 3 columns by 4 rows, equal cells, broad transparent gutters, portrait 1536 by 2048. Each row is ONE consistent vehicle design: rows from top to bottom red compact sedan; white delivery panel van; forest green pickup; yellow city taxi. Columns: rear view showing a SMALL amount of the LEFT flank (8-degree camera orbit), perfectly STRAIGHT rear view, rear view showing a SMALL amount of the RIGHT flank (8-degree camera orbit). All cars drive STRAIGHT AWAY from the viewer. No 30/45-degree quarter views, no sideways driving. Camera is low, just above a motorcycle rider's helmet, rear bumpers and roof seen naturally. Maintain identical vehicle, paint, wheelbase, proportions and scale across each row's three views. Each sprite entirely inside its cell. Tires are attached accurately to axles and rest on one common contact line at the bottom of each cell. Visible rubber tread must be vertically blurred as if rolling fast. Wheel faces have subtle radial blur. Do not draw any extra wheels outside the vehicle, no floating wheels, no perspective mismatch, no shadows disconnected from tires. No road, background, ground plate, text, labels, logos, checkerboard, vignette or UI. Crisp alpha silhouette. Lighting coherent soft overhead afternoon light; restrained highlights suitable for tinting into dusk. Vehicles have believable dimensions, rear bumper, exhaust, tail lamps, number plate, roof and windows. This is a sprite asset sheet, not a game screenshot.
